recommended_next_phase: Human priority decision required (not a PCAE phase) selecting among Priority Plan A (lowest risk/fastest: Repository Intelligence internal consumption wiring, Permission Broker CHGR-publication-path gap closure, Runtime introspection preflight-gating disclosure, rollback readiness/evidence auto-generation), Priority Plan B (highest governance value: Interactive Workflow/CHGR auto-detect+route, Publication Execution Ownership auto-invocation, Permission Broker rollback-path gap closure, CHGR downstream automatic consumption), Priority Plan C (broader connected PCAE: A+B plus Advisory-Context wiring and shell-gate audit surfacing), or another evidence-derived subset. Recommended starting point: Plan A, with Plan B as the necessary strategic follow-on. Whichever is selected, the next PCAE phase is the corresponding integration phase (first source-modifying phase in this thread), followed mandatorily by an independent batch-level End-to-End Capability Consumption Verification phase before any release-hardening phase.
summary: Phase 3D (public v0.3.2 release) was stopped before publication to ask a stronger question: which mature PCAE capabilities are implemented/verified/packaged/CLI-exposed but not yet consumed automatically by PCAE's own production workflows. Reverified the stopped-3D baseline (clean repo, origin/main..HEAD=0, no v0.3.2 tag, v0.3.1 unchanged, runtime unchanged) and carried forward the 3D artifact-reproducibility finding (unpinned hatchling; clean-clone rebuild hashes did not match 3C's frozen hashes) unresolved. Re-evaluated the complete Phase 3A capability universe (16 areas) via five parallel source-evidence research passes, building a Capability Consumption Graph with production consumer citations for every item. Classified 30 audited items: 6 Already Consumed, 1 Partially Consumed, 3 CLI-only/human-orchestrated, 10 Unconsumed Internal, 7 Trust-Blocked, 3 Not-Consumable. Headline finding: Interactive Workflow/CHGR -- PCAE's most mature governance capability -- has a clean, reusable production service layer that zero production lifecycle module calls automatically; routing into it is 100% human-typed CLI today, with one real but entirely dead programmatic-producer code path found (core/rollback_approval_evidence.py::create_rollback_approval_decision, zero callers). Repository Intelligence has zero production consumers outside its own CLI across every sub-capability. Permission Broker is correctly production-consumed for push/commit/promotion but has two small, concrete, evidence-cited gaps (rollback default path, CHGR publication path). Corrected a Phase 3A conflation: the AC-rated Authority Evaluation service (consumed via aesic into interactive_workflow) and the TB-rated Typed Authority Model (cltr/authority/, frozen-contract-blocked from all production imports) are architecturally separate packages with opposite consumption states, not one shared A/B rating. Produced Matrix A (consumption state), Matrix B (consumer gap), Matrix C (integration priority), an integration dependency graph, E2E verification designs for every recommended candidate, and three priority plans for human selection (A: lowest-risk/fastest; B: highest governance value -- CHGR auto-consumption; C: broader connected PCAE), with Plan A recommended as a starting point and Plan B as the necessary follow-on. No integration was implemented and no priority was selected -- human decision required. v0.3.2 remains NOT RELEASED; the frozen 8bb8c882 candidate is SUPERSEDED / ON HOLD pending the integration decision. Runtime unchanged (Observed/observe/unavailable). Article remains STOPPED; ~/repos/pcae-deepseek-research was not inspected.
